Important discussion how to determine if a zone should be an execution zone .  Important to consider context (are we over extended in the overnight?).  Take it step by step on each zone.  What do we need to see at the most aggressive zone to go long?  Insane NQ higher, tick, etc. -- we would take this normally.  The next zone below, we take it on first test when its extended going into it (or consider back of zone entry).  The following zone we should always take (unless liquation mode) and might need to risk 2R to get filled.  Step by Step process.

I need to move away from a predication mindset (making money focus) because my mind will only focus on the supporting info and not the unbiased market generated info.
This not a game of perfect but rather good enough.  Targets, risk reward are all determined by overall market structure, context, intraday path, etc.
It's rare that you have two losses on a day if you are objective and following the process -- not trying to predict and be emotional.

Too simplistic approach for taking the trades.  You need to consider the context.  On Monday, there was a huge gap up from Friday's close.  You can consider that most of the range has already been used up, and continued upside is limited (under typical circumstances).  Also, it was first test of the zone above in the premarket, so Aggressive support is not an area of interest for execution.  Going into Tuesday's session, much tighter overnight range, and third attempt to pierce the zone above.  More conducive for a long at aggressive support.
